runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 14:27 sweep across 13 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade LIVE item was added. Upwork surfaced multiple Worldwide VA/WordPress candidates, but the close fits were blocked by weak client trust, implausible or low fixed-price economics, language/country restrictions, competition, or hard-development requirements. Direct-company ATS discovery surfaced Bratislava-capable employer indexes including cargo-partner and Ajax Systems, but no same-run role detail cleared fit and evidence gates. Reddit results were supply-side FOR HIRE or US-only employer demand. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Compensation plausibility confidence
developmentChanges.reason: Score freelance fixed-price offers against stated scope, task volume and client history before promotion. Flag unusually high beginner payouts from brand-new/no-spend clients and extremely low fixed budgets for substantial WordPress work as trust/economics anomalies instead of treating headline pay as reliable.

developmentChanges.title: Source query yield decay tracker
developmentChanges.reason: Track which source-family query patterns repeatedly return zero relevant deltas and rotate keywords, role synonyms and direct-company ATS targets on later runs. This reduces repetitive searches and increases coverage without weakening the ranking gate.
